name: 同時に一つ選ぶセグメント切替
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Targeted correction of LH07-0025. Image1 ORIGINAL source is authority for icon geometry and fine control anatomy. Image2 is the previous generated edit target. Image3 is secondary mock for locked Japanese typography and content. Official pure-white/forest-green/slate design remains binding.
Make an appreciably denser version of Image2. This is a COMPACT UTILITY CONTROL. Exactly three Japanese options 小さめ / 標準 / 大きめ with middle selected. Total intended native dimensions180px by28px, each cell60px by28px. Preserve Meiryo Regular40012px/16px tracking0, never bold. The three-character labels occupy about60percent of their60px cell width. Padding12px per side and6px vertically. Draw the selected middle inset just1.5px, radius5px; outerradius6px and1px subtle neutralborder. White inactive cells, slate text, middle forest gradient/white text. The letters must be clearly larger relative to the available cell space than in Image2: reduce empty padding, do not merely scale the entire previous control down. No shadow beyond a tiny neutralhairline. Frame the product tightly: whole finished image should have only8px native white clearance each side of the180x28 control, minimal white canvas above/below, long thin strip. No heading, diagram, phone, dimensions, duplicate, other control or decorative card. Output may be high resolution but must preserve those exact compact proportions.
reviewNotes: 所有者指示のコンパクト化候補。基準180x28、3等分60、12/16文字。各ラベルの占有比率が上がり、横余白・高さ・角丸を縮小。日本語3語と中央選択を目視確認。画像は拡大検査用で実アプリ寸法の証明ではない。実寸プレビュー別途確認、所有者承認前。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
